thread:
maria: Heads up — seeing double quota reservations for some orgs when clients retry with slightly different Idempotency-Key variants. Putting notes here.

devon: Can you paste a tiny repro / logs? Is this per-org quota or per-key?

maria: Per-org quota. Repro looks like this: two near-simultaneous requests where the header differs only by case/whitespace. Example log snippet:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: abc-123
Content-Length: 512
...
```
then retry comes through as:
```http
POST /v1/generate
idempotency-key: abc-123 
Content-Length: 512
```
Edge treats them as different keys and reserves quota twice.

sam: Normalize at the edge (trim + lowercase) and we're golden for most clients.

rahul: Normalization helps but race is the killer — we currently reserve quota before dedupe. Two concurrent attempts can both reserve, then the dedupe later collapses to one response but quota already spent.

devon: Right — two main patterns: (A) dedupe first (lookup idemp store, return cached if present) or (B) optimistic provisional reserve then reconcile/compensate if dedup happens. A gives stronger correctness but costs a synchronous lookup on the hot path. B reduces latency but needs refund/compensate logic.

zhen: We could mark reservations as provisional in the billing ledger with a short TTL and a `dedupe_key`. If dedupe detects a duplicate, emit a compensate/refund event that clears the provisional charge. That avoids blocking on a global lookup but keeps accounting sound.

maria: Proposal: 1) normalize idempotency header at edge (trim/lower/hash), 2) create provisional reservation with TTL=10s, 3) perform dedupe check, 4) if duplicate -> cancel provisional reservation and return cached result. Canary on 5% orgs.

sam: +1. Add load tests that simulate bursts of 200 concurrent retries with tiny idemp variations. Also add metrics: `quota.reserve.provisional`, `quota.reserve.confirmed`, `quota.compensate.refunds`. Dashboards need alert if `compensate.refunds` spikes.

ops-bot: deploy plan created: feature-flag `normalize-idemp-and-provisional-reserve` -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback window 30m.

rahul: One more caveat: mobile SDKs that generate fresh idempotency keys per attempt (instead of preserving) will still cause many provisional reservations. We should update SDK docs and add an SDK warning to console telemetry for clients that don't reuse keys.

maria: Putting a small PR up now with edge normalization + provisional reserve prototype. Assigning @devon for tests, @zhen for ledger changes, @sam for dashboards/alerts. Thanks :raised_hands:

devon: I'll write the concurrency tests and add a fuzz harness for header permutations (case, unicode whitespace, trailing dots).

zhen: I'll sketch the ledger schema change: add field `provisional=true|false`, `dedupe_key_hash`, and `provisional_expires_at`. Will add a compaction job to sweep expired provisional rows and emit compensations if needed.

maria: Great. We'll sync in tomorrow's eng-platform standup if more edge cases surface.
